criteria.text: Documented stage 2 type 1 diabetes, to delay onset of Stage 3 type 1 diabetes (approval criterion 2).
Patient is 8 years of age or older (approval criterion 1).
Presence of TWO or more pancreatic islet autoantibodies: ICA, IA-2A, IAA, ZnT8A, or GAD65 (approval criterion 2a).
Dysglycemia on oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), or an alternative glycemic test if oral GTT is unavailable (approval criterion 2b).
Complete blood count AND liver enzyme panel obtained prior to initiation (approval criterion 3).
Provider submitted documentation of body surface area in m² (approval criterion 4).
Patient does not currently have Stage 3 type 1 diabetes (denial criterion 2).
No clinical history consistent with type 2 diabetes (denial criterion 3).
No active serious infection or chronic infection, including EBV or CMV (denial criterion 4).
All baseline laboratory eligibility thresholds met: lymphocytes ≥1,000/mcL, hemoglobin ≥10 g/dL, platelets ≥150,000/mcL, ALT and AST ≤2×ULN, and bilirubin ≤1.5×ULN (denial criterion 5).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Tzield (teplizumab-mzwv), a CD3-directed monoclonal antibody to delay onset of Stage 3 type 1 diabetes in patients with Stage 2 type 1 diabetes. Version 1; Original 12/27/2022; Approval 01/20/2023; Effective 03/01/2023.

Encoded: approval criteria 1–4 and denial criteria 2–5. Failure to meet approval criteria is also a denial. Autoantibody confirmation, dysglycemia, baseline panels, submitted BSA, and baseline laboratory eligibility are attestations requiring documentation verification.

Cautions (notes only): monitor liver enzymes throughout treatment; discontinue if AST or ALT >5×ULN. Monitor white blood cell counts; discontinue for prolonged severe lymphopenia (<500 cells/mcL lasting 1 week or longer). Monitor for signs/symptoms of infection; discontinue if serious infection develops.
Cautions (notes only): contraindicated during pregnancy and at least 30 days prior to planned pregnancy.
Duration (notes only): initial approval 3 months. Reauthorization not approved. Treatment consists of 14 infusions total, once daily for 14 consecutive days.

Quantity (notes only): BSA-based intravenous infusion over a minimum of 30 minutes: Day 1 65 mcg/m²; Day 2 125 mcg/m²; Day 3 250 mcg/m²; Day 4 500 mcg/m²; Days 5–14 1,030 mcg/m² daily. HCPCS J3490, J3590, C9399. max_units is null; dosing and quantity are not evaluated.
Documentation verification, monitoring, cautions, duration, no reauthorization, dosing, and quantity enforcement require manual review; this pack remains partial.
